app.name: Mise
app.tagline: Restaurant stock, shelf life and stop list

state.errorHint: Check the connection and try again.
state.notFoundText: Shall we check the other shelves?
state.noAccessTitle: This section is not for your role
state.noAccessText: If you need it for work, ask a manager to change your role.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.

auth.invalid_credentials: Couldn't sign in. Check your login and password.
auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
auth.inactive: This account is disabled. Ask a manager.
auth.demo_unavailable: Demo access isn't set up right now.

errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a minute.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

order.insufficient_stock: Not enough products for this order.
order.dish_unavailable: One of the dishes can't be ordered right now.
order.idempotency_key_reused: This order was already sent with different contents. Refresh the page.
order.invalid_transition: The order has moved on — refresh the list.
order.not_cancellable: This order can no longer be cancelled.

batch.not_writable: This delivery is already used up or written off.

unit.incompatible: This unit doesn't fit the product.

supply.duplicate_number: A delivery with this number already exists.
supply.idempotency_key_reused: This delivery was already sent with different contents. Reopen the form.

expiry.not_after_receipt: The expiry must be after the delivery date.
expiry.invalid_shelf_life: The shelf life is not valid.

product.duplicate_name: A product with this name already exists.
product.in_use: The product can't be deleted: it is in stock or used in recipes.
product.unit_locked: The unit can't change: the product already has movements.

dish.duplicate_name: A dish with this name already exists.
dish.in_use: The dish can't be deleted: it is in orders. Take it off the menu instead.

user.last_manager: You can't deactivate or demote the last manager — appoint another one first.

push.disabled: Notifications are not configured on the server.
push.endpoint_not_allowed: This browser sent an unsupported notification address.

pwa.title: App
pwa.subtitle: Install on the phone and notifications. Settings apply to this device.
pwa.updateReady: A new version of Mise is available.
pwa.offlineText: showing saved data. Orders, deliveries and write-offs can't be sent until the connection is back.
pwa.installText: Mise opens like an app: no address bar, with an icon and notifications.
pwa.installDone: Mise is installed on this device
pwa.installIos: In Safari tap “Share” → “Add to Home Screen”. On iPhone notifications work only for the installed app.
pwa.installedText: Mise runs from the home screen. Updates arrive on their own.
pwa.pushText: Spoiled products, dishes in the stop list, low stock — only what needs action in your role.

push.unsupported: This browser can't receive site notifications (or this is a development build).
push.needsInstall: On iPhone notifications work only for the app on the home screen: “Share” → “Add to Home Screen”.
push.serverOff: Notifications are not configured on the server.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked in the browser settings — allow them for this site and come back.

pwa.keepAwakeText: For a kitchen tablet: while Mise is open, the screen doesn't sleep.
pwa.pushTestFailed: Couldn't deliver. Turn notifications off and on again.
